concerns.text: Task T044c permits the pipeline to finish gracefully with “No significant enrichment” when no GO term meets the adjusted p‑value < 0.05 threshold, directly contradicting Success Criterion SC‑002 which requires at least one significant GO term per species. This weakens the specification.

Integration test T020a asserts that the edge‑list contains ≥ 10 000 edges via a reference to undefined task T042. Because T042 does not exist, the acceptance criterion for edge count is not actually verified, violating the US‑1 acceptance scenario.

Task T005 claims the CI workflow file `.github/workflows/ci.yml` is added, yet the file is missing. This omission breaks the CI infrastructure promised in the plan and undermines FR‑009 (or related CI‑related requirements).
